note: Package constants for tomato3d.topview (same role as tomato3d/state/p1_config.json). Every value names its source; provisional values say so.

leaflet_true_aspect_range.source_ref: docs/정의집_토마토_2026-10-11.md, 소엽 길이·폭: 장폭비 = 길이/폭 (실측 범위 1.4-1.7)

compound_threshold_note: compound boxes use the same measure_min_confidence, which was derived for leaflets only; no compound-specific threshold has been derived (every compound row is proposed, a person decides)

box_majority_frac.source_ref: majority: more than half of the leaflet's box (or mask) lies in the compound

membership.rule: candidate compounds = boxes holding the majority of the leaflet's box; one -> member; several -> the one holding the majority of the leaflet's mask if exactly one does, else ambiguous; none -> unassigned

detector.measure_min_confidence_source_ref: F1-best leaflet threshold (IoU 0.5, leaf+terminal_leaf+leaf2 merged) on the 4 real v4 valid/test photos, 2026-10-12: F1 0.798 at 0.25, flat 0.78-0.80 over 0.25-0.65; valid images were used for model selection, so in-sample-ish. Re-derive on the C6-top reference set when it exists. ADDENDUM 2026-10-12 (real link): 2 of those 4 photos are ALSO in v4 train as 'top_heic' copies (IMG_8328 = dwt_104, IMG_8338 = dwt_105; identical 64 px thumbnails) - the threshold and the real reference APs are partly in-sample.
